t: Hidden removable fixing for all tongue and groove flooring, including hard and softwoods and fibreboards. Tri-Lock TS thread won't split timber, won't loosen and requires no pilot hole. No more glues, nails or squeaky boards. Boards can be lifted without damage. Self-countersinking lost head. Yellow net coating. 200 screws will fix up to 10m².
b: Small Head Fixes Flush for an Almost Hidden Finish
TS Thread System Offers a Single & Twin Thread in One, Gripping Fast with a Firm Fix
